page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Top: printed page number "3" centred above a printer's ornament rule. Then a centred title block in large capitals. Below it, the body text in one column. At the foot, the gathering signature "A 2".

main_text.head: FIDEI MOSIS AMYRALDI, CIRCA ERRORES ARMINIANORUM, DECLARATIO.
main_text.p: QUIA nonnulla de Mosi[?] AMYRALDO circa errores Arminianorum jactata sunt, à quibus vehementissimè semper abhorruit, eo autem est loco à Deo constitutus vt bene an secus de Gratia ipsius sentiat, cōmunis ædificationis interest ne quemquam bonorum lateat, fidem suam catenus breviter hic declarare statuit.
Ea de quibus Orthodoxis & Arminianis inter se controversia est, ad hæc quinque præcipua capita omnino referuntur. I. Quæ sit corruptio naturæ hominis, &

page.notes: The initial Q of "QUIA" is a large woodcut initial, joined to the first word as instructed. "Mosi" in the first line is partly damaged: the final letter looks like a t or i, so it is marked [?]. The line "Ea de quibusOrthodoxis" has the words run together in the print; I left them as printed. The line "Quæ sit" has a smudge over the Q. The ornament rule above the title is decorative and not transcribed. Show-through and scan edges are not transcribed.
